root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `g_resolver_records_from_res_query()` aliases `answer` as a DNS `HEADER`, it must require `len >= sizeof (HEADER)` so every header field later consumed is inside the reply buffer.
root_cause_criterion.description: In the vulnerable original the one-byte reply reaches this guard site with `len = 1` and `sizeof (HEADER) = 12`, so the bound is false while the protected `header->qdcount` read still executes. In the fixed original the same one-byte witness is guarded before `qdcount_read`, and the closest 12-byte boundary reply provides the genuine witness that the protected read executes only when `len >= sizeof (HEADER)` holds.

nodes.state: The parser reinterprets the same `answer` buffer as `const HEADER *header`, so later field accesses treat the fuzz reply bytes as a fixed DNS header layout.
Immediately before the AddressSanitizer-reported line, `count = ntohs (header->qdcount);` dereferences the aliased DNS header pointer.

edges.relation: The same `answer` pointer that bypasses the incomplete length gate is immediately cast to `header`.
The same `header` alias created from the undersized reply is the pointer dereferenced at the `qdcount` read sink.
